builds.message:
studio: V4.5 tranche 2 — Models page, Generate input media slots, pane drawers (1.6.0)

- MANAGE > Models: dedicated read-only catalog page (search, type filters,
  availability, capabilities, presets, LoRA inventory) with 'Open in
  Generate' deep link; nav-models no longer routes to the workflow view
- Generate: input media slots derived from the model's inputs metadata;
  each slot maps to WanGP's native ATTACHMENT_KEYS (image_guide/
  video_guide/audio_guide), uploads through /api/media/upload and writes
  the returned path into the settings JSON - no invented parameters reach
  the backend; applyInputPath is a pure exported helper (e2e-tested)
- Workflow panes as drawers at 1024-1439px: the canvas becomes a
  two-column grid, the inspector slides over it from the toolbar toggle
  (kept above the drawer so the toggle stays clickable), the library is
  collapsible too; canvas keeps the visual priority per the concept

E2E: 3 new tests (models page honest state + Generate deep link,
attachment-key mapping, slot rendering from faked model detail). Full
suite 19/19 x2; strict units 108 passed.

studio: V4.5 concept parity — IA regroup, Generate/Queue/Image Editor views, health-derived runtime status (1.6.0)

Information architecture per docs/superpowers/specs/WANGP_STUDIO_UI_CONCEPT.md:
- sidebar groups WORKSPACE (Dashboard, Generate, Workflow), LIBRARY (Media
  Center, Image Editor), MANAGE (Models, Queue), SYSTEM (Resource Center,
  Plugins, Settings); the dead History stub and MODEL TYPES shortcuts are
  gone; old hashes (#library, #media, #history) still route
- Generate view: model picker (search + category filters + availability),
  native defaults + presets, prompt/negative prompt, full settings JSON;
  submits through POST /api/jobs -> the single native queue
- Queue view: full Studio job history (the drawer keeps the 20-card window),
  nav badge counts active jobs
- Image Editor view: honest dependency state from /api/environment
  (enabled/disabled/not_installed) with a matching recovery action; the
  editor itself is never duplicated
- runtime status derived from /api/health (sidebar card, topbar pill,
  footer, body.runtime-down), polled every 30s; catalog errors no longer
  masquerade as a down runtime
- design tokens moved to the concept palette; focus-visible outlines;
  execution drawer collapsible (respects prefers-reduced-motion);
  responsive: compact icon sidebar + stacked panels at <=1024px

Layout fix (latent since 1.4.x): grid items of .main-area now carry
min-width:0 — the drawer's flex row of job cards set the intrinsic
min-content (~4900px with 39 jobs) and stretched every sibling, pushing
the Inspector off-screen.

E2E: test_v45_views.py (7 tests: nav groups, health status, generate
empty state, queue rendering, dependency state, drawer toggle, hash
aliases). Version 1.6.0.
studio: import pytest in the e2e gallery suite (CI has no ffmpeg, the skip path crashed with NameError)

studio: v4-audit hardening (1.5.1)

P0/P1 fixes from the 6 Nov technical audit plus e2e-stability repairs:

- studio.js: onNodeSelected used an undefined helper S.esc (P0) - local esc
- canvas.js/editor.js: load_graph reassigned const graph (P0) - let graph;
  applyNodeSettings now clears an empty prompt and merges data.params
- workflow_compat: run worker releases models unconditionally on failed/
  cancelled runs that actually executed a generation node, never while
  another run is active (others_active gate); graph_types hoisted before
  the try so the finally block cannot hit unbound locals; cancelled runs
  with outputs report cancelled+partial instead of completed
- workflow.js: unified origin-checked message handling; flushPendingMedia
  handshake; pending-media queue (mirrored in wanflow-ui editor.js)
- studio.js applyToNode routes params vs settings by node kind
- plugin: /api/media/roots honors ?force=1 (was silently ignored - the
  gallery could serve a stale listing after new outputs); atomic jobs
  history writes under a lock; no-store Cache-Control on /api responses
- gallery.js: lightbox shows the workflow name (graph_name) of a file
- media_ops: ffmpeg subprocess gets stdin=DEVNULL
- e2e: chain test stable (poll API-verified oldest-name, canvas handshake
  poll); use_in_workflow clicks a disk-verified card; conftest logs 5xx
  response URLs; thumbnail-engine stub moved before create_web_app
- tests: release-paths suite (failed/cancelled unconditional, success
  honors unload flags); jobs SSE restart/repeat coverage

Version 1.5.1. Wanflow-ui fork: 152ec52, e9ca5d8, 84744a8, 3de2645.

studio: V4.1 node inspector bridge + V4.3 restorable run graphs + V4.4 job persistence (1.5.0)

- V4.1 Inspector: selecting a node on the canvas pushes node_selected to
  the host; the right panel loads the node's model settings through the
  existing native editor and offers 'Apply to selected node' (prompt,
  model_type, settings merge) via the canvas apply_node_settings action
  (third documented vendored patch, mirrored in the fork editor);
- V4.3: run sidecars now store the full normalized graph — the lightbox
  gains 'Open workflow', which reloads the run's graph onto the canvas
  (load_graph action) even after a host restart;
- V4.4: terminal jobs persist to workspaces/studio_jobs.json (bounded
  50), /api/jobs merges disk records after a restart, and repeat works
  for restart-era jobs from the disk history; workspaces_dir overridable
  via server_config for tests;
- version 1.5.0.

studio: workflow runs release models on failure and cancellation (V4.0 P0)

The v4 audit flagged the stranded-VRAM risk: the run worker only bound
its release hook after a successful run_graph, so failed and cancelled
runs never released anything - and the Studio host had no release_model
at all, so the fork's honoring releaser was a silent no-op.

- WanGPStudioPlugin.release_model() bridges to the already-loaded wgp
  runtime module (no import-time work, no second runtime);
- the run worker releases unconditionally on failed/cancelled outcomes
  and honors the graph unload flags on success;
- the wanflow fork exposes release_loaded_model for exactly that;
- release-path unit tests via a stub runner.

* fix(studio): make workflow run a single guarded canvas action

* fix(studio): wire primary run to canvas and restore queue links

studio: Unified Media & Workflow Experience (1.4.0)

P1 complete:
- Media -> Workflow: the gallery lightbox 'Use in workflow' drops the
  file onto the canvas as an input node (fork: input nodes accept
  params.path before runtime slots; host push action 'add_media');
- Workflow -> Gallery: finished runs write {workflow: {run_id, graph}}
  sidecars next to their outputs (merge-safe, output-root scoped);
  the lightbox shows 'Graph · run id';
- Generation History: jobs store their settings; POST
  /api/jobs/{id}/repeat resubmits them; the tasks panel gains Repeat
  and 'View results in Gallery' shortcuts.

P2:
- Workflow templates: built-in T2V/I2V/T2I starter graphs served from
  the plugin's own graph_model, importable with zero unknown nodes;
- drag & drop media onto the canvas toolbar uploads and adds input
  nodes;
- queue cards link to the results in the Gallery.

P3:
- Plugin Health records the last 50 scans into
  workspaces/studio_plugin_health.json and the Plugins view shows the
  recent scan history.

Version 1.4.0. Strict regression: 242 passed (CUDA required run).

studio: Generation History — repeat jobs with their original settings (1.4.0 P1.3)

- _JobRecord stores the submission payload (deep copy) and the snapshot
  carries it;
- job submission is refactored into _start_job(), shared by POST
  /api/jobs and the new POST /api/jobs/{id}/repeat — a finished or
  failed job re-submits its stored settings through the same
  validation/session path;
- the Studio tasks panel gains a Repeat button on completed/failed
  jobs; tests pin the resubmitted payload equality and the 404.
studio: soak waits on base+1 — reading the total after set_input_files raced the XHR

studio: Workflow -> Gallery — runs link their outputs (1.4.0 P1.2)

A finished workflow run writes a sidecar next to every file it produced
inside the plugin's workflow_outputs root: {workflow: {run_id, graph}}.
Existing sidecars (WanGP's own settings JSON) merge instead of being
replaced, and files outside the output root are never touched.

media_index.detail surfaces the workflow record, and the lightbox shows
'Graph name · run id' as a fact row — closing the loop from the 1.4.0
flagship scenario back to the Gallery.

Integration test: input_video(path) + ffmpeg_trim run through the real
run worker, sidecar verified on disk and through MediaIndex.detail;
helper is unit-tested to never touch files outside the output root.

studio: pending-media queue survives canvas activation races

activate() rebuilds the canvas frame from an empty literal, so media
nodes folded into state.graph were lost on the CI timing. addMediaInput
now queues requests until a frame exists and every buildFrame flushes
them after the srcdoc script installs its message listener.

studio: Media -> Workflow — gallery files land on the canvas (1.4.0 P1)

The flagship 1.4.0 scenario starts: a gallery file becomes a workflow
input node. The lightbox gains 'Use in workflow' (image/video/audio):
it switches to the canvas and adds an input_image/video/audio node with
the file path preset; the runner consumes params.path before the
runtime upload slots (fork commit 152ec52).

- vendored canvas gets its second documented patch: host push action
  'add_media' -> addMediaNode (mirrors the fork editor.js);
- workflow.js addMediaInput() pushes to a live canvas or folds the node
  into the graph buildFrame() will render; getGraph() exported for tests;
- e2e: gallery -> lightbox -> Use in workflow -> the canvas graph carries
  input_image with the corpus file path.

studio: soak clears filters before capturing its base total

The control-audit CI run exposed an order dependence: kind_filter_and_search
leaves 'prompt hint 3' in the search box, so the soak captured 400 as its
base and then waited forever for the unfiltered count to equal it. The soak
now clears the filter first, waits for the fetch queues to drain, and only
then captures the base.
docs: plan Studio 1.4.0 — Unified Media & Workflow Experience

studio: audit hardening from the 1.3.4 control review (1.3.5)

- upload history is bounded: finished entries beyond 100 leave the
  queue (and the DOM), and a successful upload releases the File
  reference; failed/cancelled entries keep it for retry;
- loadPage markers are generation-scoped tokens ("gen:page"): a stale
  request's finally can no longer un-mark the current request for the
  same page after a filter reset;
- e2e regression for the empty uploads panel visibility (the exact bug
  live acceptance caught) and an honest deep-scroll content check (the
  far end must actually show the oldest corpus file);
- new manual/weekly Media benchmark workflow runs the 10k perf tests
  (slim deps: pillow, psutil, pytest).
studio: hide the empty uploads panel (display:grid overrode the hidden attribute)

studio: stage-E soak test and gate env isolation

- e2e long-session soak: four deep scroll cycles, a full refresh,
  search round-trip and an upload; asserts the page store, DOM window
  and selection stay bounded afterwards (plus a JS-heap report);
  totals are relative to whatever earlier tests added, so the soak is
  order-independent
- the gate skip-branch test neutralizes WANFLOW_REQUIRE_CUDA: under the
  strict acceptance run the mock would otherwise (correctly) raise

ci: stub the thumbnail engine in e2e instead of chasing its dep chain

The preview import chain reaches rembg, whisper and more - installing
that universe into the e2e runner is a treadmill. The harness tests
gallery bounds, not preview rendering: sys.modules stub makes every
thumbnail request fail fast and deterministically (broken-image state),
the connection pool stays free, and the job keeps the slim dependency
set. test_thumbnail_bytes still covers the real engine where the chain
imports.
